new.name: Bluegill Candy
new.description: A tiny bluegill fly with a white slotted tungsten bead, a black micro Ultra Chenille body and speckled centipede legs.
new.fishing_tips: Let it sink near beds and twitch it; the legs do the work.
steps: Slide on the bead and start the thread behind it.
Tie in the chenille at the bend, leaving a short tail.
Wrap the chenille forward, tying in a pair of legs halfway and another behind the bead.
Coat the wraps with thin UV resin and finish.

new.name: Brenda
new.description: A bright sea trout and trout fly with a gold bead, a rainbow Salmo Supreme body, a ginger saddle and crystal flash tail and a ginger saddle hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it for sea trout along coasts or for trout in rivers.
mats: Ginger Keough saddle and tan Crystal Flash
steps: Slide on the bead and tie in a ginger saddle tail with flash.
Dub a rainbow body.
Tie in a ginger saddle behind the bead.
Wind the hackle and finish.

new.name: Coastfly CDC Emerger
new.description: A quill-bodied emerger with a fluorescent yellow quill, a UV resin coat and a two-tone yellow and blue dun CDC wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the film during hatches.
mats: Fluorescent yellow and blue dun CDC
steps: Tie in a fluorescent yellow quill and wrap it around the bend.
Coat the quill with mid-flex UV resin.
Tie in a CDC wing of yellow and blue dun feathers.
Build a small thread thorax and finish.

new.name: McPhail CDC Spinner
new.description: A spinner with microfibbet tails, an amber-coloured thread body, a tan and orange thorax and CDC wings.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it at dusk during spinner falls.
mats: Cahill thread coloured with amber pen
steps: Tie in split tails.
Build a thread body and colour the rib with amber pen.
Tie in CDC wings spent on each side.
Dub the thorax around the wings.

new.name: CDL Shrimp
new.description: A sea trout and saltwater shrimp with a mallard and Coq de Leon tail, shrimp eyes, peach Superhair antennae, a pink SLF body and a palmered CDL hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slowly along shallow coasts.
mats: Fluorescent shell pink SLF saltwater dubbing
steps: Tie in the tail, eyes and antennae at the bend.
Tie in a Coq de Leon hackle.
Dub the pink body forward.
Palmer the hackle through it and finish.

new.name: Char Foam
new.description: A bright floating char fly with an orange polar fox and rubber leg tail, a pearl crystal chenille body and an orange foam back.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on a sinking line so it floats up off the bottom.
mats: Orange polar fox, orange Crystal Flash and barred rubber legs
steps: Tie in the fox, flash and legs at the bend.
Tie in the foam at the bend and the chenille.
Wrap the chenille forward.
Pull the foam over the top and tie it off at the eye.

new.name: Coal Car
new.description: A Northwest steelhead fly with a black tail, a yellow, orange and black body, a black hen hackle and a black squirrel wing.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it for winter steelhead.
mats: Yellow-orange wool, orange wool and black chenille
steps: Tie in the tail and rib.
Wrap the three-part body.
Rib it and wind the hackle.
Tie in the squirrel wing and finish.

new.name: Crabbie Chan
new.description: A small crab for sea trout and carp with bead chain eyes, shrimp eyes, a grizzly marabou tail, a braid back and flash fibre and silicone legs.
new.fishing_tips: Let it settle and twitch it slowly.
mats: Tan sculpin flash fibre and barred silicone legs
steps: Tie on the bead chain and shrimp eyes.
Tie in a marabou tail.
Build a thread body with legs on each side.
Pull the braid over the back and finish.

new.name: Crystal Midge
new.description: A stillwater midge with a peacock herl body, a fine wire rib and a crystal chenille thorax.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it under an indicator in lakes.
steps: Slide on a bead if using one and tie in the rib.
Wrap a peacock herl body.
Rib it to protect the herl.
Wrap a short crystal chenille thorax.

new.name: Darbee Stonefly Nymph
new.description: Harry Darbee's stonefly with pheasant tail tails, a D-Rib rib, an amber seal's fur body, jungle cock eye wing cases and partridge legs.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep in Catskill-style rivers.
steps: Tie in split tails and the rib.
Dub the body and rib it.
Tie in jungle cock eyes flat as wing cases.
Add partridge legs and finish.

new.name: Deer Hair Ant
new.description: A simple ant made only of black deer hair folded into two humps, with the tips left as legs.
new.fishing_tips: Drift it under trees on summer days.
steps: Tie in deer hair by the tips at the bend.
Fold it forward to form the rear hump.
Leave a few tips out as legs at the waist.
Fold the hair again to form the head and trim.

new.name: Foam Wing Caddis
new.description: A caddis with a dubbed body, a foam wing cut to shape and a hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it during caddis hatches; it floats all day.
mats: 2 mm foam, cut to a wing shape
steps: Dub a slim body on the rear two thirds.
Cut a foam wing to a caddis shape and tie it flat on top.
Tie in a brown hackle.
Wind it in front of the wing and finish.

new.name: Harrop Ant
new.description: Rene Harrop's ant with a mixed-colour dubbed butt, moose hair legs, a duck quill wing and a barred ginger hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it during summer ant falls.
mats: Rusty brown, mahogany and amber superfine
steps: Dub a round butt.
Tie in moose legs and a quill wing.
Wind a few turns of hackle.
Dub a small head and finish.

new.name: Hatching Midge
new.description: A tiny hatching midge with a black thorax and a grizzly hackle on a curved dry hook.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it to sipping fish on still water.
steps: Build a slim black thread body around the bend.
Dub a small black thorax.
Tie in a grizzly hackle and wind two turns.
Trim the hackle flat underneath so it sits in the film.

new.name: Hen Spinner
new.description: A spinner with microfibbet tails, a dubbed body and spent hen hackle tip wings.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the film at evening spinner falls.
steps: Tie in split tails.
Dub a slim abdomen.
Tie hen tips spent on each side.
Dub a thorax around the wings.

new.name: Iain Bain Special
new.description: A Scottish salmon fly with a chartreuse butt, yellow bucktail tail, a silver holographic body, a red tippet and squirrel wing and a blue hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in summer water.
steps: Tie a silver tag, a chartreuse butt and a yellow bucktail tail with flash.
Wind a silver holographic body and rib it with wire.
Tie in a red tippet and grey squirrel wing.
Wind a blue hackle collar and finish.

new.name: McFly Jerk Bait
new.description: A jointed jerkbait fly with a foam core inside crinoline tubing, epoxy eyes and a UV resin finish.
new.fishing_tips: Twitch it and pause for bass and pike.
steps: Cut a tapered 2 mm foam core and lash it to the shank.
Slide crinoline tubing over the foam and tie it down at both ends.
Join a second section with trailer wire if you want it jointed.
Glue on epoxy eyes and coat the head with thin UV resin.

new.name: Little Brown Stone
new.description: A small dry stonefly with a pheasant tail tail, a brown dubbed body, a grizzly tip wing and grizzly hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in early spring when little brown stones hatch.
steps: Tie in a short tail.
Dub the body and rib it.
Tie a hackle tip flat as a wing.
Wind the hackle.

new.name: Pattegrisen Slo Mo
new.description: A slow-sinking sea trout shrimp with a mallard and spey hackle tail, shrimp eyes, an SLF body, a palmered spey hackle and a foam back.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slowly on a floating line.
mats: Mallard flank, Whiting spey and pink Supreme Hair
steps: Add weight and a fluorocarbon guard.
Tie in the tail and eyes.
Dub the body and palmer the hackle.
Pull the foam back over and rib with mono.

new.name: Profile Spinner
new.description: A spinner with a biot body, a cerise post for visibility, silver poly wings and a hackle wound parachute style.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it at dusk; the cerise post is easy to track.
steps: Tie in split tails and wrap a biot body.
Tie in a short cerise post.
Tie a poly wing across the hook.
Wind the hackle around the post.

new.name: Red Abbey
new.description: A classic salmon fly with a red tail, a red floss body ribbed with silver, a brown hen hackle, a squirrel wing and jungle cock.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it in medium water.
steps: Tie the tag and tail.
Wind a red floss body and rib it.
Add a brown hen hackle.
Tie in the wing and jungle cock.

new.name: Rio Bandito
new.description: A crayfish-coloured jig nymph with a gold tungsten bead, an Aussie possum body and sili legs.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it for cichlids, panfish and trout.
steps: Slide on the gold tungsten bead.
Dub a buggy possum body.
Tie in sili legs on each side at the thorax.
Pick out the dubbing and finish behind the bead.

new.name: Sam's One Bug
new.description: A bright floating bug with a gold flash and marabou tail, a yellow foam cylinder body, silicone legs, a red foam wing and UV eyes.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it near the surface for trout and sea trout.
mats: Gold Crystal Flash with yellow and orange marabou
steps: Tie in a tail of yellow and orange marabou with gold flash.
Lash a yellow foam cylinder on top of the shank.
Tie in silicone legs and a red foam wing at the tie-down point.
Paint eyes on the foam with UV resin.

new.name: Shimazaki CDC Ant
new.description: A CDC ant with a black abdomen, a black hackle thorax and a dun and white CDC wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it under trees in summer.
steps: Dub a round black abdomen.
Tie in a dun and white CDC wing at the waist.
Wind a black hackle for legs.
Dub a small black head.

new.name: Silver Fox Nymph
new.description: A nymph with a silver fox tail and body, a silver wire rib, a duck slip wing case and a black soft hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it as a general nymph.
steps: Tie in a short silver fox tail and the silver wire.
Dub a body of silver fox fur and rib it with wire.
Tie in a duck quill slip over the thorax as a wing case.
Wind a black soft hackle, pull the wing case forward and finish.

new.name: Streaking Caddis
new.description: A big skating caddis with a brown dubbed body and a spun deer hair wing.
new.fishing_tips: Skate it at dusk in summer.
steps: Dub a slim brown body on the rear two thirds.
Stack and tie in a bunch of deer hair as a flat wing.
Spin more deer hair in front for a collar and head.
Trim the head flat on the bottom so it skates.

new.name: Texas Midge
new.description: A tiny midge larva with a red and black thread body, a red D-Rib and a UV finish.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep in tailwaters.
steps: Wrap a smooth red thread underbody around the bend.
Tie in red D-Rib and wrap it forward for segmentation.
Build a small black thread head.
Coat the whole fly with UV resin.

new.name: Brahma Bugger
new.description: A woolly bugger with a chickabou tail, holographic flash and a body of wound Brahma hen soft hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it slowly for trout and panfish.
mats: Brahma hen saddle soft hackle, wound
steps: Tie in a chickabou tail with a few strands of holographic flash.
Tie in a Brahma hen saddle by the tip.
Wind the hackle forward in close turns, stroking the fibres back.
Coat the head with thin UV resin.

new.name: McFly Carp Bug
new.description: A carp fly with bead chain eyes, an olive rabbit tail, a variegated chenille body and a Brahma soft hackle collar.
new.fishing_tips: Drop it in front of carp.
steps: Tie on bead chain eyes so the fly rides point up.
Tie in an olive rabbit zonker tail.
Wrap a variegated chenille body.
Wind a Brahma soft hackle collar and finish.

new.name: Trout Candy
new.description: A small foam yellow stonefly dry with a snowshoe wing and grizzly hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in summer.
steps: Tie in a thin strip of yellow foam and fold it forward to make a body.
Tie in a light snowshoe hare's foot wing over the body.
Tie in a grizzly hackle.
Wind it and trim the foam head.

new.name: Ultra Light Streamer
new.description: A big, light predator streamer with layers of nayat, bucktail, Polar Flash and grizzly saddles, a Predator Dubbing collar and 3D eyes.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it for pike.
mats: Holographic long hair chenille and white bucktail
White nayat, Polar Flash, cerise bucktail, grizzly saddles, black bucktail
steps: Tie in long hair chenille and white bucktail as the tail.
Layer the wing: white nayat, Polar Flash, cerise bucktail, grizzly saddles and black bucktail on top.
Wind a collar of black and pink Predator Dubbing.
Glue on 3D eyes and coat the head with flexible UV resin.

new.name: Woodcock Wet
new.description: A wet fly with a turkey tail, a hare's ear body, a gold rib and a woodcock hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in a team of wets.
steps: Tie in a tail of brown and claret turkey fibres and the gold rib.
Dub a hare's ear body.
Rib it with oval gold tinsel.
Wind a woodcock hackle and finish with a red head.

new.name: X2 Caddis
new.description: A caddis with an amber Zelon shuck, a green hare's mask body, a white Zelon underwing and an elk wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it during caddis hatches.
steps: Tie in a short amber Zelon shuck.
Dub a green hare's mask body.
Tie in a white Zelon underwing and an elk hair wing.
Dub a small head in front of the wing.

new.name: Yellow Mayfly
new.description: A pale yellow mayfly with a CDL tail and body and grizzly march brown and dun hackles.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it during light mayfly hatches.
mats: Grizzly march brown and grizzly dun
steps: Tie in CDL fibres for the tail.
Wrap CDL fibres forward as the body.
Tie in the two grizzly hackles at the thorax.
Wind them together and finish.
